domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTkZnXtRhuEiiyidvJ

HTTP reach for this card, from area S4's real-boot measurement on #33456 (the os-dev-report there, cell 3). Showcase dev boot (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`, SQLite file DB), main `63e47feeca`:

- A package-less `probe_approve_m` was saved on `showcase_invoice` (200). Then the writable package `com.probe.alpha` was created (`POST /api/v1/packages`, 201), and `PUT ?package=com.probe.alpha` saved the same name on `showcase_task` (200).
- `GET /api/v1/meta/action` lists ALPHA's `probe_approve_m` (on `showcase_task`) only. The environment's row on `showcase_invoice` is absent.
- Yet `POST /api/v1/actions/showcase_invoice/probe_approve_m` and `/actions/_env/showcase_invoice/probe_approve_m` both judge that environment item: the refusal names its own target `https://env.example.invalid/m`.
- The engine registry holds both: the objectql log shows the bare slot `Registered action: probe_approve_m` beside the overlay slot `com.probe.alpha probe_approve_m`, on save and again after a restart.
- The reading is identical after the restart.

So the listing hides an item the execution door serves, on a real composition, not only in the #32681 harness.

A second reading, for the seat's maintainer batch (not a defect claim). This is cell 4 of the same report. A package-less `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/probe_approve_p` (on `showcase_task`) of a name that only the writable package `com.probe.beta` holds (on `showcase_invoice`) answered 200: `Saved action probe_approve_p (env-wide, package=com.probe.beta, state=active)`. The save is re-addressed into BETA, and BETA's declaration moves to `showcase_task`. The receipt names the package, so it is not silent.

Prior rulings read: ADR-0150 L181 ("A package-less row that bears a package-held name is a customization, never a second item … A bucket-4 item is therefore one whose `(type, name)` no package holds") and R15 (L311: package-less overlay rows over a package-held name are a customization of the one holder). These read the save as BETA's customization, as the door does. ADR-0150 D4 table L158/L163 keys the action engine by `(package, objectName, name)`, so an environment action on a different object is a different key and arguably no customization of BETA's. The two texts point different ways only for actions bound to different objects. No ⛔ line covers that case, and no test pins either reading (grep of `protocol-save.ts` tests for a cross-object package-less action save: none found by the probe). Related, same ADR: S5's disabled-only bare-save question (#33955 / PR #33889).

domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTkZnXtRhuEiiyidvJ

Correction to the Prior-rulings line in my comment above ("no test pins either reading"). `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts` pins the re-addressing for a type-agnostic item, in describe "a package-less direct save of an item ONE package owns writes that package's row" (L234: the receipt names the package, and no second row is written). That pin is generic. No case binds an action to a different object than the holder's. So the pinned reading is the bucket-4/R15 one, and the cross-object action case is the unpinned gap the maintainer question is about.

Folded here as a second acceptance item (seat's request, 15:43Z). The finding is area S5's, out_of_scope_findings of report 6897015058 on #33385, with dedupe words: action envelope _packageId, package-less action other object, disabled holder action withheld.

Acceptance item 2 (read face, same seam family): a package-less registry action bound to object B must not wear `_packageId` of a holder (disabled or not) whose artifact of that name is bound to object A. `GET /meta/action/NAME` must not withhold it (404) on the strength of that stamp. ADR-0150 D4 keys the action by `(package, objectName, name)`, so the environment's item on B is its own item.

Premise first: re-measure on main at or after `68e726d631` (PR #33898, merged 2026-11-15T15:18Z). That PR makes `readMetaItem` graft an action's artifact envelope only from a package whose own artifact is bound to the served item's object (`lookupArtifactItem` with the owner key, in `protocol-artifact-lookup.ts`, plus `artifactOwnerKeyOf` in `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`). That is very likely this shape. S5's probe read "the same answer on origin/main". Its branch had merged main at `74b5505a`, and I cannot tell whether that included #33898. If the re-measure on current main shows the 404 gone, this item is satisfied by #33898 with a test pin added for the disabled-holder variant. Otherwise the fix goes at that graft.

## HTTP reach measured for the read half 2026-11-16T02:55Z

From the #34059 dev report (comment 6905929323 on #34059, open question 1 and out-of-scope finding 1), real showcase dev boot (SQLite), main `571cf9082a` plus PR #34238:

- Writable P holds action `probe_approve_p` on `showcase_invoice`. The environment's own package-less row of that name sits on `showcase_task`, which PR #34238's save writes and which the other save order (environment first, then `?package=P`) already stores on main.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/action/probe_approve_p` (bare) and `GET /api/v1/meta/action` both serve P's item. `?package=_env` answers 409 naming P and the environment. The environment's item runs at `/actions/_env/showcase_task/probe_approve_p` but has no by-name read.
- The dev places the seam at `packagelessContentPackage` (it takes the stored rows' one binding), in `protocol-meta-item-reads` / `protocol-environment-rows`. This is beside the listing merge this card already names.

The listing half's "no HTTP reach today" no longer holds once #34238 merges: the state is then one package-less save away, and on main it is reachable now through the environment-first order. The ruling on #34059 (option B) binds that save, read and execution agree at D4's action key. This card is the read half of that ruling. When it unblocks (`Blocked-by: #34059`), triage should regrade it from p3.

## Widened to the delete door 2026-11-16T03:16Z

Contract review 6906251635 on PR #34238 (S1) found this by reading the code: a package-less `DELETE` of an action name takes the one package binding as its address, whatever unbound row is stored beside it (`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`, the delete address). So with P's row on A and the environment's own row on B, a package-less delete removes P's row and leaves the environment's. It is reachable on main through the environment-first save order, and on #34238's main path once that merges.

It belongs with the read and list halves already here: D4's action key `(package, objectName, name)` is not applied at that door. This card now covers the by-name read, the list and the delete. #34238 pins today's answers for the read and the delete as marked FROM, so the fix here turns them.
